tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i rten bca' ba sogs la mkho ba'i sngags byang bzhugs/1$0000300 na maḥpadma shrī he ru kā ya/ rgyu sngags ni hūm̐ yig go /bzlas pa ni hrīḥbadzra kro ta sogs so// dbang sdud sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥhrīḥpadmānta kṛta wa shaṃ ku ru hrī: ha ya gṛ wa wa shaṃ ku ru hrī: tsandhe shwa ri wa shaṃ ku ru hrī: padma rā ga wa shaṃ ku ru hrī: hrīḥdabang wa shaṃ ma na ya hrī hrīṃḥdzaḥdza: rā ga dun dun: dgug pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ badzra kro dha tsandha rā ga padmānta kṛta ha ya gṝ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: ma mā shwa ri padma rakṣa bhyo kro dha thum ril: rakṣa srog la bhyo: nṛ aṃ ku sha dzaḥdza: srog khug sa ma ya dza: drag sngags bdun pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥpadma bhan dha hrīḥdabang*/ hrīḥtsan dha rakṣa srog la rbad/ hrīḥpadmānta kṛta snying la rbad/ hrīḥha ya ghrī wa mā ra ya rbad/ hrīḥpad mo dha ra rā ga mā ra ya rbad/ ma ma trag shig tsitta la rbad bhyo: kro dha rakṣa dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya rbad/ rbad nan bhyoḥ thun sngags ni/ hrīḥha ya ghrī wa rakṣa rbad thun sod/ padmānta kṛta dgra bo'i snying la thun rbad/ ma ma rakṣa dgra bo'i srog la thun rbad/ rag mo tsha la dun snying la khos rbad/ kro dha rakṣa dha ra dgra bo'i snying la thun mā ra ya rbad/ zlog pa'i sngags/ hrīḥpadma ma hā shrī he ru ka badzra ghrī wa ha ya kro dha badzra ma ma kro ta pa ṭa tsa na rakṣa ma ma shwa ri sha tra tro he krid krid/ padma shrī he ru kaḥ shad shad dzaḥphaṭa/ dgra bo'i tsitta sa ma ya thun rbad/ srog la mā ra ya rbad/ mā ra ya sod/ ma hā ba la padma krid/ suṃ maṃ khaṃ baṃ st+waṃ bha ya nan/ thog 'beb sngags/ hrīḥraṃ wa shaṃ ku ru padma bhandha dha/ padmo dha ya/ tsandha rā ga /padma te dza dzwa la raṃ/ ma ma shwa ri trag rakṣa/ khrag la rngubs/ dzwa la raṃ/ rā hu la si si dza: badzra yakṣa dzwa la raṃ/ ma ma khrag la mu sha dzwa la raṃ/

ma ma khrag la mu sha ma bhyoḥ tsa ra mu sha dzwa la raṃ/ badzra shad shad/ dgra bo 'khor dang bcas pa'i srog la rbad/ raṃ thog thog gnam lcags ur mo dgra bo'i srog la bhyoḥbhyoḥ mā ra ya rbad/ phobs phobs/ ser ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ padmānta kṛta phrom phrom/ ha ya ghī/ phrom phrom/ ma ma trag rakṣa phrom phrom/ hu lu hu lu phrom phrom/ badzra rakṣa ga te phrom phrom/ ma ra tsa sha phrom phrom/ hrīl hril shar shar drag tu hril bhyoḥ hūm̐ la phrom/ rā hu la badzra yakṣa ma snyil/ sa ma khrag hril shar lo thog la phaub/ ma hā khrag la mu sham/ snying tsa sha ma ma bhyoḥ ma ma rā tsa sha hril/ 'u ya ma tri sib bhyoḥ lo thog la phob/ oṃ hrīḥwā shaṃ ku ru padma shrī he ru ka ha ya ghṝ wa/ padma rā ga tsi nra hri nā ga shu la/ de wī trig nan/ lo thog la bha ri sha ya rbad/ ha na ha na shar phob ya/
zhes pa rnams nyer mkho'i slad du pod gzhung las phyungs pa dge/ //
